sanskrit: lohāśavaktro jaṭharaḥ kumbhavaktraś ca kuṇḍakaḥ madgugrīvaś ca kṛṣṇaujā haṃsavaktraś ca candrabhāḥ
english: Iron-horse-faced Jaṭhara, and Kuṇḍaka with a face like a pot, and Madgugrīva the diver-necked, and Kṛṣṇaujas of dark might, and goose-faced Candrabhās of moonlike sheen.

sanskrit: pāṇikūrmā ca śambūkaḥ pañcavaktraś ca śikṣakaḥ cāṣavaktraś ca jambūkaḥ śākavaktraś ca kuṇḍakaḥ
english: And Śambūka with hands like a tortoise, and Śikṣaka the five-faced, and Jambūka with the face of a blue jay, and Kuṇḍaka of the herb-leaf countenance.

sanskrit: yogayuktā mahātmānaḥ satataṃ brāhmaṇapriyāḥ paitāmahā mahātmāno mahāpāriṣadāś ca ha yauvanasthāś ca bālāś ca vṛddhāś ca janamejaya
english: Yoked in yoga, great of soul, ever dear to the brāhmaṇas, descended from the Grandsire, lofty-spirited, mighty attendants — youths in their prime, and children, and the aged too, O Janamejaya.

sanskrit: sahasraśaḥ pāriṣadāḥ kumāram upatasthire vaktrair nānāvidhair ye tu śṛṇu tāñ janamejaya
english: By the thousand the attendants drew near to wait upon the Prince; and those who bore faces of every kind — hear of them now, O Janamejaya.

sanskrit: kūrmakukkuṭavaktrāś ca śaśolūkamukhās tathā kharoṣṭravadanāś caiva varāhavadanās tathā
english: With faces of tortoise and cock, and others with the muzzles of hare and owl, and some with the faces of ass and camel, and others with the snouts of boars.

sanskrit: manuṣyameṣavaktrāś ca sṛgālavadanās tathā bhīmā makaravaktrāś ca śiṃśumāramukhās tathā
english: With the faces of men and rams, and others with the muzzles of jackals, and terrible ones with the maws of sea-monsters, and faces like the river-dolphin's.

sanskrit: mārjāraśaśavaktrāś ca dīrghavaktrāś ca bhārata nakulolūkavaktrāś ca śvavaktrāś ca tathāpare
english: With the faces of cat and hare, and long-faced ones, O Bhārata, with the faces of mongoose and owl, and yet others dog-faced.

sanskrit: ākhubabhrukavaktrāś ca mayūravadanās tathā matsyameṣānanāś cānye ajāvimahiṣānanāḥ
english: With the faces of mouse and ichneumon, and the countenances of peacocks, and others fish-faced and ram-faced, and some bearing the faces of goat, sheep, and buffalo.

sanskrit: ṛkṣaśārdūlavaktrāś ca dvīpisiṃhānanās tathā bhīmā gajānanāś caiva tathā nakramukhāḥ pare
english: With the faces of bear and tiger, and the countenances of leopard and lion, and terrible ones with the faces of elephants, and others with the maws of crocodiles.

sanskrit: garuḍānanāḥ khaḍgamukhā vṛkakākamukhās tathā gokharoṣṭramukhāś cānye vṛṣadaṃśamukhās tathā
english: With the faces of the eagle and the rhinoceros, and the faces of wolf and crow, and others with the faces of ox, ass, and camel, and some with the muzzles of the wildcat.

sanskrit: mahājaṭharapādāṅgās tārakākṣāś ca bhārata pārāvatamukhāś cānye tathā vṛṣamukhāḥ pare
english: With huge bellies, feet, and limbs, and eyes like stars, O Bhārata, and others with the faces of doves, and yet others with the faces of bulls.

sanskrit: kokilāvadanāś cānye śyenatittirikānanāḥ kṛkalāsamukhāś caiva virajombaradhāriṇaḥ
english: And others with the faces of cuckoos, and countenances of hawk and partridge, and some with the faces of chameleons, clad in spotless garments.

sanskrit: vyālavaktrāḥ śūlamukhāś caṇḍavaktrāḥ śatānanāḥ āśīviṣāś cīradharā gonāsāvaraṇās tathā
english: Serpent-faced, with faces like spear-points, fierce-faced, hundred-faced, venomous as fanged snakes, clad in bark, and shrouded like the bull-nosed cobra.

sanskrit: sthūlodarāḥ kṛśāṅgāś ca sthūlāṅgāś ca kṛśodarāḥ hrasvagrīvā mahākarṇā nānāvyālavibhūṣitāḥ
english: With swollen bellies yet slender limbs, and bulky limbs yet lean bellies, short-necked, large-eared, adorned with serpents of every kind.

sanskrit: gajendracarmavasanās tathā kṛṣṇājināmbarāḥ skandhemukhā mahārāja tathā hy udaratomukhāḥ
english: Robed in the hides of lordly elephants, and clad in black antelope-skins, some with faces set in their shoulders, O great king, and some with faces set in their bellies.

sanskrit: pṛṣṭhemukhā hanumukhās tathā jaṅghāmukhā api pārśvānanāś ca bahavo nānādeśamukhās tathā
english: Some with faces in their backs, some with faces upon their jaws, and some with faces upon their shanks, and many with faces in their flanks, with faces set in every region of the body.

sanskrit: tathā kīṭapataṃgānāṃ sadṛśāsyā gaṇeśvarāḥ nānāvyālamukhāś cānye bahubāhuśirodharāḥ
english: And there were troop-lords with mouths like those of worms and winged insects, and others with the faces of sundry beasts of prey, bearing many arms and heads.

sanskrit: nānāvṛkṣabhujāḥ ke cit kaṭiśīrṣās tathāpare bhujaṃgabhogavadanā nānāgulmanivāsinaḥ
english: Some with arms like the branches of various trees, others with heads set at their hips, with faces like the coils of serpents, dwelling among the many thickets.

sanskrit: cīrasaṃvṛtagātrāś ca tathā phalakavāsasaḥ nānāveṣadharāś caiva carmavāsasa eva ca
english: With bodies wrapped in bark, and clothed in plates of wood, wearing garb of every fashion, and some clad only in hides.

sanskrit: uṣṇīṣiṇo mukuṭinaḥ kambugrīvāḥ suvarcasaḥ kirīṭinaḥ pañcaśikhās tathā kaṭhinamūrdhajāḥ
english: Wearing turbans and diadems, with necks ringed like the conch, of radiant splendor, crowned, some with five locks of hair, and others with stiff, bristling hair.

sanskrit: triśikhā dviśikhāś caiva tathā saptaśikhāḥ pare śikhaṇḍino mukuṭino muṇḍāś ca jaṭilās tathā
english: With three locks, with two locks, and others with seven locks, some with crests, some crowned, some shaven bald, and others with matted hair.

sanskrit: citramālyadharāḥ ke cit ke cid romānanās tathā divyamālyāmbaradharāḥ satataṃ priyavigrahāḥ
english: Some bearing wreaths of many hues, and some with hairy faces, wearing divine garlands and raiment, ever pleasing in their forms.

sanskrit: kṛṣṇā nirmāṃsavaktrāś ca dīrghapṛṣṭhā nirūdarāḥ sthūlapṛṣṭhā hrasvapṛṣṭhāḥ pralambodaramehanāḥ
english: Dark of hue, with fleshless faces, long-backed and belly-less, some thick-backed, some short-backed, with dangling bellies and pendulous parts.

sanskrit: mahābhujā hrasvabhujā hrasvagātrāś ca vāmanāḥ kubjāś ca dīrghajaṅghāś ca hastikarṇaśirodharāḥ
english: Great-armed and short-armed, with stunted bodies, dwarfish, hunchbacked, with long shanks, and bearing the ears and heads of elephants.

sanskrit: hastināsāḥ kūrmanāsā vṛkanāsās tathāpare dīrghoṣṭhā dīrghajihvāś ca vikarālā hy adhomukhāḥ
english: With the noses of elephants, of tortoises, and others with the noses of wolves, with long lips and long tongues, ghastly, and downward-faced.

sanskrit: mahādaṃṣṭrā hrasvadaṃṣṭrāś caturdaṃṣṭrās tathāpare vāraṇendranibhāś cānye bhīmā rājan sahasraśaḥ
english: With great tusks and small tusks, and others with four tusks, some like lordly elephants, terrible, O king, by the thousand.

sanskrit: suvibhaktaśarīrāś ca dīptimantaḥ svalaṃkṛtāḥ piṅgākṣāḥ śaṅkukarṇāś ca vakranāsāś ca bhārata
english: With shapely, well-proportioned bodies, blazing, finely adorned, tawny-eyed, with pointed ears and crooked noses, O Bhārata.

sanskrit: pṛthudaṃṣṭrā mahādaṃṣṭrāḥ sthūlauṣṭhā harimūrdhajāḥ nānāpādauṣṭhadaṃṣṭrāś ca nānāhastaśirodharāḥ nānāvarmabhir ācchannā nānābhāṣāś ca bhārata
english: With broad fangs and great tusks, thick-lipped, with tawny lion-hair, having feet, lips, and tusks of every kind, and hands and heads of every kind, sheathed in armor of every sort, and speaking tongues of every kind, O Bhārata.

sanskrit: kuśalā deśabhāṣāsu jalpanto 'nyonyam īśvarāḥ hṛṣṭāḥ paripatanti sma mahāpāriṣadās tathā
english: Skilled in the speech of every land, these lordly ones chattered to one another; and so the mighty attendants leapt about in their delight.

sanskrit: dīrghagrīvā dīrghanakhā dīrghapādaśirobhujāḥ piṅgākṣā nīlakaṇṭhāś ca lambakarṇāś ca bhārata
english: Long-necked, long-nailed, with long feet, heads, and arms, tawny-eyed and blue-throated, and with drooping ears, O Bhārata.

sanskrit: vṛkodaranibhāś caiva ke cid añjanasaṃnibhāḥ śvetāṅgā lohitagrīvāḥ piṅgākṣāś ca tathāpare kalmāṣā bahavo rājaṃś citravarṇāś ca bhārata
english: Some with bellies like wolves', some dark as collyrium, with white bodies and crimson necks, others tawny-eyed, and many of mottled and motley hue, O king, of dappled colors, O Bhārata.

sanskrit: cāmarāpīḍakanibhāḥ śvetalohitarājayaḥ nānāvarṇāḥ savarṇāś ca mayūrasadṛśaprabhāḥ
english: Resembling clusters of yak-tail plumes, streaked with white and crimson, of varied hues and of single hue, with a luster like the peacock's.

sanskrit: punaḥ praharaṇāny eṣāṃ kīrtyamānāni me śṛṇu śeṣaiḥ kṛtaṃ pāriṣadair āyudhānāṃ parigraham
english: Hear now once more as I tell of their weapons; for the remaining attendants had taken up arms as their own.

sanskrit: pāśodyatakarāḥ ke cid vyāditāsyāḥ kharānanāḥ pṛthvakṣā nīlakaṇṭhāś ca tathā parighabāhavaḥ
english: Some with hands raised aloft bearing nooses, with gaping maws and ass-faces, broad-eyed and blue-throated, and with arms like iron clubs.

sanskrit: śataghnīcakrahastāś ca tathā musalapāṇayaḥ śūlāsihastāś ca tathā mahākāyā mahābalāḥ
english: Bearing in their hands the śataghnī and the discus, and grasping pestles, holding spears and swords, of huge frame and mighty strength.

sanskrit: gadābhuśuṇḍihastāś ca tathā tomarapāṇayaḥ asimudgarahastāś ca daṇḍahastāś ca bhārata
english: Bearing maces and the bhuśuṇḍi in their hands, and grasping lances, holding swords and mallets, and wielding staves, O Bhārata.

sanskrit: āyudhair vividhair ghorair mahātmāno mahājavāḥ mahābalā mahāvegā mahāpāriṣadās tathā
english: With dread weapons of every kind, lofty of spirit, swift of pace, mighty in strength and impetus — such were these great attendants.

sanskrit: abhiṣekaṃ kumārasya dṛṣṭvā hṛṣṭā raṇapriyāḥ ghaṇṭājālapinaddhāṅgā nanṛtus te mahaujasaḥ
english: Beholding the consecration of the Prince, those lovers of battle rejoiced, and with their limbs bound about with nets of bells, those puissant ones fell to dancing.

sanskrit: ete cānye ca bahavo mahāpāriṣadā nṛpa upatasthur mahātmānaṃ kārttikeyaṃ yaśasvinam
english: These and many other mighty attendants, O king, drew near to wait upon the great-souled and glorious Kārttikeya.

sanskrit: divyāś cāpy āntarikṣāś ca pārthivāś cānilopamāḥ vyādiṣṭā daivataiḥ śūrāḥ skandasyānucarābhavan
english: Heavenly and aerial and earthly, swift as the wind, those heroes, appointed by the gods, became the followers of Skanda.

sanskrit: tādṛśānāṃ sahasrāṇi prayutāny arbudāni ca abhiṣiktaṃ mahātmānaṃ parivāryopatasthire
english: Of such as these, by the thousands, the millions, and the hundred-millions, they surrounded the consecrated great-souled one and stood in attendance upon him.

sanskrit: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca śṛṇu mātṛgaṇān rājan kumārānucarān imān kīrtyamānān mayā vīra sapatnagaṇasūdanān
english: Vaiśaṃpāyana said: Hear now, O king, of these troops of mothers, the followers of the Prince, whom I shall celebrate, O hero — destroyers of the hosts of his foes.

sanskrit: yaśasvinīnāṃ mātṝṇāṃ śṛṇu nāmāni bhārata yābhir vyāptās trayo lokāḥ kalyāṇībhiś carācarāḥ
english: Hear the names of the glorious mothers, O Bhārata, by whom — auspicious ones — the three worlds, with all that moves and is unmoving, are pervaded.

sanskrit: prabhāvatī viśālākṣī palitā gonasī tathā śrīmatī bahulā caiva tathaiva bahuputrikā
english: Prabhāvatī, Viśālākṣī, Palitā, and Gonasī, Śrīmatī, and Bahulā, and likewise Bahuputrikā.

sanskrit: apsujātā ca gopālī bṛhadambālikā tathā jayāvatī mālatikā dhruvaratnā bhayaṃkarī
english: And Apsujātā and Gopālī, and Bṛhadambālikā, Jayāvatī, Mālatikā, Dhruvaratnā, Bhayaṃkarī.

sanskrit: vasudāmā sudāmā ca viśokā nandinī tathā ekacūḍā mahācūḍā cakranemiś ca bhārata
english: Vasudāmā and Sudāmā, Viśokā, and Nandinī, Ekacūḍā, Mahācūḍā, and Cakranemi, O Bhārata.

sanskrit: uttejanī jayatsenā kamalākṣy atha śobhanā śatruṃjayā tathā caiva krodhanā śalabhī kharī
english: Uttejanī, Jayatsenā, then Kamalākṣī and Śobhanā, and Śatruṃjaya likewise, Krodhanā, Śalabhī, Kharī.

sanskrit: mādhavī śubhavaktrā ca tīrthanemiś ca bhārata gītapriyā ca kalyāṇī kadrulā cāmitāśanā
english: Mādhavī and Śubhavaktrā, and Tīrthanemi, O Bhārata, Gītapriyā and Kalyāṇī, Kadrulā, and Amitāśanā.

sanskrit: meghasvanā bhogavatī subhrūś ca kanakāvatī alātākṣī vīryavatī vidyujjihvā ca bhārata
english: Meghasvanā, Bhogavatī, and Subhrū, and Kanakāvatī, Alātākṣī, Vīryavatī, and Vidyujjihvā, O Bhārata.

sanskrit: padmāvatī sunakṣatrā kandarā bahuyojanā saṃtānikā ca kauravya kamalā ca mahābalā
english: Padmāvatī, Sunakṣatrā, Kaṇḍarā, Bahuyojanā, and Saṃtānikā, O Kaurava, and Kamalā the mighty.

sanskrit: sudāmā bahudāmā ca suprabhā ca yaśasvinī nṛtyapriyā ca rājendra śatolūkhalamekhalā
english: Sudāmā and Bahudāmā, and Suprabhā the glorious, and Nṛtyapriyā, O lord of kings, and Śatolūkhalamekhalā, girt with a hundred mortars.

sanskrit: śataghaṇṭā śatānandā bhaganandā ca bhāminī vapuṣmatī candraśītā bhadrakālī ca bhārata
english: Śataghaṇṭā, Śatānandā, and Bhaganandā the comely, Vapuṣmatī, Candraśītā, and Bhadrakālī, O Bhārata.

sanskrit: saṃkārikā niṣkuṭikā bhramā catvaravāsinī sumaṅgalā svastimatī vṛddhikāmā jayapriyā
english: Saṃkārikā, Niṣkuṭikā, Brahmā, Catvaravāsinī, Sumaṅgalā, Svastimatī, Vṛddhikāmā, Jayapriyā.

sanskrit: dhanadā suprasādā ca bhavadā ca jaleśvarī eḍī bheḍī sameḍī ca vetālajananī tathā kaṇḍūtiḥ kālikā caiva devamitrā ca bhārata
english: Dhanadā and Suprasādā, and Bhavadā, and Jaleśvarī, Eḍī, Bheḍī, and Sameḍī, and Vetālajananī, mother of the ghoul, and Kaṇḍūti, and Kālikā, and Devamitrā, O Bhārata.

sanskrit: lambasī ketakī caiva citrasenā tathā balā kukkuṭikā śaṅkhanikā tathā jarjarikā nṛpa
english: Lambasī and Ketakī, and Citrasenā, and Balā, Kukkuṭikā, Śaṅkhanikā, and Jarjarikā, O king.

sanskrit: kuṇḍārikā kokalikā kaṇḍarā ca śatodarī utkrāthinī jareṇā ca mahāvegā ca kaṅkaṇā
english: Kuṇḍārikā, Kokalikā, and Kaṇḍarā, and Śatodarī, Utkrāthinī, and Jareṇā, and Mahāvegā, and Kaṅkaṇā.

sanskrit: manojavā kaṇṭakinī praghasā pūtanā tathā khaśayā curvyuṭir vāmā krośanātha taḍitprabhā
english: Manojavā, Kaṇṭakinī, Praghasā, and Pūtanā, Khaśayā, Curvyuṭi, Vāmā, Krośanā, and Taḍitprabhā, bright as the lightning.

sanskrit: maṇḍodarī ca tuṇḍā ca koṭarā meghavāsinī subhagā lambinī lambā vasucūḍā vikatthanī
english: Mandodarī and Tuṇḍā, and Koṭarā, Meghavāsinī, Subhagā, Lambinī, Lambā, Vasucūḍā, Vikatthanī.

sanskrit: ūrdhvaveṇīdharā caiva piṅgākṣī lohamekhalā pṛthuvaktrā madhurikā madhukumbhā tathaiva ca
english: And Ūrdhvaveṇīdharā, who wears her braid upturned, tawny-eyed Lohamekhalā girt with iron, broad-faced Pṛthuvaktrā, Madhurikā, and Madhukumbhā likewise.

sanskrit: pakṣālikā manthanikā jarāyur jarjarānanā khyātā dahadahā caiva tathā dhamadhamā nṛpa
english: Pakṣālikā, Manthanikā, Jarāyu, Jarjarānanā, and she renowned as Dahadahā, and likewise Dhamadhamā, O king.

sanskrit: khaṇḍakhaṇḍā ca rājendra pūṣaṇā maṇikuṇḍalā amocā caiva kauravya tathā lambapayodharā
english: And Khaṇḍakhaṇḍā, O lord of kings, Pūṣaṇā, Maṇikuṇḍalā, and Amocā, O Kaurava, and Lambapayodharā with pendulous breasts.

sanskrit: veṇuvīṇādharā caiva piṅgākṣī lohamekhalā śaśolūkamukhī kṛṣṇā kharajaṅghā mahājavā
english: And Veṇuvīṇādharā, bearing flute and lute, tawny-eyed Lohamekhalā girt with iron, hare-and-owl-faced, dark of hue, with ass's shanks, and very swift.

sanskrit: śiśumāramukhī śvetā lohitākṣī vibhīṣaṇā jaṭālikā kāmacarī dīrghajihvā balotkaṭā
english: Śiśumāramukhī with the face of a river-dolphin, Śvetā the white, Lohitākṣī the red-eyed, Vibhīṣaṇā the terrible, Jaṭālikā, Kāmacarī who roves at will, Dīrghajihvā the long-tongued, and Balotkaṭā of surpassing strength.

sanskrit: kāleḍikā vāmanikā mukuṭā caiva bhārata lohitākṣī mahākāyā haripiṇḍī ca bhūmipa
english: Kāleḍikā, Vāmanikā, and Mukuṭā, O Bhārata, Lohitākṣī the red-eyed, Mahākāyā of huge frame, and Haripiṇḍī, O lord of the earth.

sanskrit: ekākṣarā sukusumā kṛṣṇakarṇī ca bhārata kṣurakarṇī catuṣkarṇī karṇaprāvaraṇā tathā
english: Ekākṣarā, Sukusumā, and Kṛṣṇakarṇī the dark-eared, O Bhārata, Kṣurakarṇī the razor-eared, Catuṣkarṇī the four-eared, and Karṇaprāvaraṇā who is mantled in her ears.

sanskrit: catuṣpathaniketā ca gokarṇī mahiṣānanā kharakarṇī mahākarṇī bherīsvanamahāsvanā
english: Catuṣpathaniketā who dwells at the crossroads, Gokarṇī the cow-eared, Mahiṣānanā the buffalo-faced, Kharakarṇī the ass-eared, Mahākarṇī the great-eared, and she whose voice resounds like the kettledrum.

sanskrit: śaṅkhakumbhasvanā caiva bhaṅgadā ca mahābalā gaṇā ca sugaṇā caiva tathābhīty atha kāmadā
english: And she whose voice is like conch and pot, Bhaṅgadā the mighty, Gaṇā and Sugaṇā, and Abhīti the fearless, and Kāmadā the granter of desires.

sanskrit: catuṣpatharatā caiva bhūtitīrthānyagocarā paśudā vittadā caiva sukhadā ca mahāyaśāḥ payodā gomahiṣadā suviṣāṇā ca bhārata
english: And Catuṣpatharatā who delights in the crossways, Bhūtitīrthā, Anyagocarā, Paśudā giver of cattle, and Vittadā giver of wealth, and Sukhadā of great fame, giver of joy, Payodā giver of milk, Gomahiṣadā giver of cow and buffalo, and Suviṣāṇā the fair-horned, O Bhārata.

sanskrit: pratiṣṭhā supratiṣṭhā ca rocamānā surocanā gokarṇī ca sukarṇī ca sasirā stherikā tathā ekacakrā megharavā meghamālā virocanā
english: Pratiṣṭhā and Supratiṣṭhā, Rocamāna, Surocanā, Gokarṇī and Sukarṇī, Sasirā, and Stherikā likewise, Ekacakrā, Megharavā whose roar is the thundercloud, Meghamālā garlanded with clouds, and Virocanā.

sanskrit: etāś cānyāś ca bahavo mātaro bharatarṣabha kārttikeyānuyāyinyo nānārūpāḥ sahasraśaḥ
english: These and many other mothers, O bull of the Bharatas, followers of Kārttikeya, of every form, by the thousand.

sanskrit: dīrghanakhyo dīrghadantyo dīrghatuṇḍyaś ca bhārata saralā madhurāś caiva yauvanasthāḥ svalaṃkṛtāḥ
english: Long-nailed, long-toothed, and long-snouted, O Bhārata, yet upright and sweet, in the bloom of youth and finely adorned.

sanskrit: māhātmyena ca saṃyuktāḥ kāmarūpadharās tathā nirmāṃsagātryaḥ śvetāś ca tathā kāñcanasaṃnibhāḥ
english: Endowed with grandeur of soul, able to take any shape at will, some with fleshless bodies and white of hue, and others gleaming like gold.

sanskrit: kṛṣṇameghanibhāś cānyā dhūmrāś ca bharatarṣabha aruṇābhā mahābhāgā dīrghakeśyaḥ sitāmbarāḥ
english: Others like the black thundercloud, and some smoke-gray, O bull of the Bharatas, some glowing like the dawn, the highly blessed, long-haired and white-robed.

sanskrit: ūrdhvaveṇīdharāś caiva piṅgākṣyo lambamekhalāḥ lambodaryo lambakarṇās tathā lambapayodharāḥ
english: And some wearing their braids upturned, tawny-eyed, with pendant girdles, with hanging bellies, with drooping ears, and likewise with pendulous breasts.

sanskrit: tāmrākṣyas tāmravarṇāś ca haryakṣyaś ca tathāparāḥ varadāḥ kāmacāriṇyo nityapramuditās tathā
english: With copper-red eyes and copper hue, and others tawny-eyed, granters of boons, roving at will, and ever joyous.

sanskrit: yāmyo raudryas tathā saumyāḥ kauberyo 'tha mahābalāḥ vāruṇyo 'tha ca māhendryas tathāgneyyaḥ paraṃtapa
english: Some belonging to Yama, some to Rudra, and some to Soma, those of Kubera, and the mighty, those of Varuṇa, and those of great Indra, and those of Agni, O scorcher of foes.

sanskrit: vāyavyaś cātha kaumāryo brāhmyaś ca bharatarṣabha rūpeṇāpsarasāṃ tulyā jave vāyusamās tathā
english: And those of Vāyu, and those of Kumāra, and those of Brahmā, O bull of the Bharatas, equal to the apsarases in beauty, and like the wind in swiftness.

sanskrit: parapuṣṭopamā vākye tatharddhyā dhanadopamāḥ śakravīryopamāś caiva dīptyā vahnisamās tathā
english: In speech like the cuckoo, and in abundance like Kubera the lord of wealth, in valor the equals of Śakra, and in radiance like the fire.

sanskrit: vṛkṣacatvaravāsinyaś catuṣpathaniketanāḥ guhāśmaśānavāsinyaḥ śailaprasravaṇālayāḥ
english: Dwelling among trees and at the crossroads, making their abodes at the meeting of four ways, dwelling in caverns and burning-grounds, and lodging by mountains and waterfalls.

sanskrit: nānābharaṇadhāriṇyo nānāmālyāmbarās tathā nānāvicitraveṣāś ca nānābhāṣās tathaiva ca
english: Wearing ornaments of every kind, garlanded and robed in every fashion, in garb of manifold and wondrous sorts, and speaking tongues of every kind as well.
